About

I’m a Data Scientist with a strong foundation in machine learning and PhD in bioinformatics. Experienced in working with complex, noisy, and high-dimensional data for revealing meaningful patterns and drive actionable insights. My background in bioinformatics has trained me to navigate messy unstructured datasets where extracting signal from noise is critical. I now apply that same mindset across domains to solve real-world problems wherever data is incomplete, ambiguous, or difficult to work with. I specialize in:

  • Machine Learning & Predictive Modeling
  • Data Cleaning, Feature Engineering & Pattern Discovery
  • Working with High-Dimensional & Unstructured Data
  • End-to-End Problem Solving: from raw data to insights Beyond traditional ML, I’m actively exploring Agentic AI systems to build frameworks for decision-making AI applied to solve complex, multi-step problems in dynamic environments. I’m particularly interested in opportunities across industries where data complexity is a challenge that includes tech, healthcare, finance, and emerging AI applications.
